purpose: Draws and edits the Endpoint line of a Value card: the Subject and the Reference, each a type picked from the ontology (with its picture and definition) and some words, and a button that finds the types for an older "Subject = X, reference = Y" text, giving every change up whole through onChange.
namedChanges: Imports: `../../lib/base/planValue` and `../../lib/base/planValueModel` are `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-card-model` (`carryRaw` and the type `EndpointPart`, checked to be exported there); `../../lib/base/planCard` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-plan-card-facts` (`planSourceEmpty`); `./TypeChooser` and the type `TypeOption` of `../../lib/base/typeSearch` are `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-type-chooser`; `./TypeTermPopover` and `TypePictureButton` of `./TypePicture` are `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-type-term-popover`; the shared pieces above are from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-line-kit`.

`useShell()` (source lines 1376 in `TypeChip` and 1395 in `PartPicture`) is `useValueLinesHost()` of the kit; the line read `openOntologyConcept` from it, and now reads it from the host of the lines (member `openOntologyConcept?: (typeName: string) => void`).

`GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN` (from `lib/base/stakeholderKinds`) is `termOrigin()` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-term-origin`, in the same expressions: `${termOrigin()}/base/t/${o.typeName}` in `PartPicker` (source line 1441) and in `FindTypes` (line 1476).

`PartPicker` (source line 1435): the `TypeChooser` got its search, its reach note and its icons from its own defaults in the app. It now gets them from the host of the lines: the new line `const { searchTypes, blankReach, renderTypeIcon } = useValueLinesHost();` and the props `search={searchTypes} blankReach={blankReach} renderTypeIcon={renderTypeIcon}`.

`FindTypes` (source line 1466): `searchLiveTerms(...)`, the app's search, is `searchTypes(...)` of the host of the lines (the new first line `const { searchTypes } = useValueLinesHost();`). It is the same function the chooser of 4 gets, as in the source, where both used `searchLiveTerms`.

Comments: none of these symbols carried a name or a tag; the file's header comment is the unit's own, and the comment block above `typeNameOf` in the source (two lines, not part of a symbol) is not copied.
`tsconfig.json` leaves out `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, which the app's source is not compiled with.
